verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Honeycomb's hosted service: OTLP ingestion into Honeycomb, EU or North America account regions, and SaaS pricing plans. Nothing documents a self-hosted production deployment, its architecture, or an upgrade path.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can run the full observability stack self-hosted in production with documented architecture and upgrade path
